hints: The authenticator is unable to find a valid CR token file when none is explicitly provided.
Look at the `ContainerTokenManager` class - it tries to read from a default file location.
When no CR token filename is given, the authenticator falls back to a default path that does not exist.
brief.lesson: The fix adds a second default CR token filename (`/var/run/secrets/tokens/sa-token`) so the authenticator can try an alternative location if the primary default file is missing.
